editorial.last_message: Completed the Rust LAS implementation; unchanged source passes all 223 tests under LAS 2.0.4. The prior sole failure was an ambiguous deprecated-waveform-bit requirement.
editorial.notes: Completed a dependency-free Rust implementation, release build, 18 unit tests and one CLI test; optional rustfmt/clippy downloads were blocked, but generation and grading completed normally. The deprecated-bit ambiguity is repaired: prior LAS 2.0.3 222/223 becomes 223/223. The original generation grade was 222/223 under LAS 2.0.3. This official zero-inference regrade uses the committed 2.0.4 suite and the pinned offline Docker image. Its complete 223-node outcome mapping matches the independently validated scratch report. All 222 unchanged node outcomes match the 2.0.3 baseline; only the renamed negative is semantically replaced. The new negative declares external waveform storage while retaining internal packet data and keeps the internal bit clear; it does not duplicate the both-bits-set check. Acceptance/rejection solely for a clear deprecated internal bit remains unscored.  No remaining failed cases were observed. Full original transcript/source reviews are carried forward with their reviewer, content hash and path below. Those earlier reviews are historical evidence; their former tool-count exactness claims are superseded by the current session-based audit. Audited v2 tool calls: 28; preserved original recorded count: 28. Input, output, cache and reasoning totals reparse exactly and remain complete; all token/cost fields and generation metadata are preserved. Regrading adds no model calls or generation cost. Original result/source/session/raw reports and previous regrade history remain unchanged. Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.
